explanation: Controller with hover vehicle reaches waypoint exactly at step 1147 (x=18.213..., y=3.458... equal to waypoint, speed ~1.8e-13). Next step 1148 all state becomes null/NaN. Likely controller velocity-error law normalizes zero distance/error vector without guard, producing non-finite force integration.
vision_note: In tiles 1145 to 1147 the red violating body moves slightly rightward near the right wall with no apparent anomaly. At tile 1148 the red body abruptly vanishes leaving only the green waypoint cross on an otherwise empty white arena, indicating the simulation state became null/NaN and could no longer be rendered.
